name: a session ping at an entry's own instant is that entry: one pasted entry alone never reaches the UNASKED threshold
notes: §7 v1.17 (SEC-2, Decisions [3.close]): a pasted log's timed entry is both a session ping (its minute, `claims.import` activeAt) and an activity entry (its claim). A session ping and an activity entry of one agent at one instant are one fact: when activityLogAdjacent fires and every session ping within ±sessionMin sits at the instant of an entry within ±adjacentMin of the anchor, only the heavier of the two signals fires (activityLogAdjacent on a tie: both weigh 4000 bp), so one entry never sums two weights. A ping at any other instant is a fact of its own and still counts.

Story. Muse's pasted log holds two calendar actions, 'Created "Q3 review"' at 14:02 and 'Created "Board prep"' at 16:02, and one line that is no claim, 'Checked the board pack' at 16:06. So Muse's session pings are 14:02, 16:02 and 16:06, and its entries are the two claims. No idle data. The person sends three vendor emails themselves: o1 at 14:02, o2 at 14:03, o3 at 16:03. Gmail Sent [12:00, 17:00] is synced at 17:00.

o1 (14:02) and o2 (14:03): the 14:02 entry is within ±2 min and no assignable Muse email.sent claim is near → activityLogAdjacent fires; the only ping within ±10 min is 14:02, the instant of that entry → one fact, adjacency alone: 4000 bp = 2/5 < 6/10 → no UNASKED receipt. v1.16 summed session 4000 + adjacency 4000 = 8000 bp from that one entry: UNASKED, FINAL, likely Muse, for sends the person made.

o3 (16:03): the 16:02 entry fires adjacency; the pings within ±10 min are 16:02 (that entry's instant) and 16:06, an instant no entry has → agentSessionActive fires on its own → 4000 + 4000 = 8000 bp = 4/5 ≥ 6/10 → UNASKED, likely Muse, reasons unasked.session, unasked.adjacent. FINAL: Muse's last import at 17:00 ≥ 16:03 + beforeClaimMin 2 + graceMin 30 = 16:35.

c1 and c2 (calendar.created, targetAt Wed 10-07 10:00 and 15:00): the week [10-04, 10-11] of every calendar, bound to acct-a, synced 17:00 (after each grace sync, 14:33 and 16:33) holds no event → match.none, full, fresh → not_found, NOT_FOUND, FINAL.
